subject: Next steps: design-first ops runbook demo + infra checklist
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@wavecare.io>, Tom Harper <tharper@wavecare.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: design-first ops runbook demo + infra checklist

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your engineering and security teams the details they need: 

Summary:
- Goal: run a concise, design-first demo focused on ops runbook + infra checklist for running Redwood Inference in your environment (VPC, data flow, KMS, audit logs).
- Duration: 45 minutes (30 min demo + 15 min Q/A).
- Deliverable: shared ops checklist and a short follow-up doc with configuration recommendations.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue May 18, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed May 19, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu May 20, 09:00–09:45 PT

Attendees we recommend from your side (please confirm names/roles):
- Elena Morales — Product/PO (you)
- Tom Harper — Lead DevOps/Platform
- 1x security/infosec reviewer (SOC2/KMS ownership)

For prep, could you confirm:
1) Preferred slot from the three above (we'll send calendar invite + bridge once confirmed).
2) Whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for the session.
3) Any constraints around test data or access (e.g., we should avoid sample PII).

Pre-demo checklist (we'll run through these briefly during the session):
- Network: will the demo run in your VPC or do you prefer Redwood-hosted sandbox?
- Keys: KMS/HSM integration question — do you have a KMS key we should reference (tokenized only)?
- Audit: desired retention window for request/response logs (30 / 90 / 365 days).
- Compliance: any additional evidence you want us to bring (SOC2 controls, data flow diagram).

Attached: wavecare_security_questionnaire.pdf (quick copy of the typical security pack we send).

If you confirm a time today, we'll follow up with a calendar invite (ICS) + Zoom link and a short agenda. Ben will lead the demo and Priyom will cover infra/quantization questions.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0164
https://www.redwood.inference/

Attendees confirmed from WaveCare: 
- Elena Morales — Product (PO)
- Tom Harper — Lead DevOps (will bring the VPC/network context)
- Priya Singh — Security Engineer (keeps SOC2 artifacts)

Requests before the demo: 
- Can you include the SOC2 control mapping PDF or a pointer to the specific controls you cover? Our security reviewer will want to prep.
- Please avoid demo traffic with real customer data; sanitized/sample payloads only.

If you send the invite I will route it to our calendar and Priya will confirm.

Thanks,
Elena
